item_name: Rothco Marine Semper Fi Low Profile Cap
item_short_desc: Show your pride with the Rothco Marine Semper Fi Low Profile Cap. This officially licensed cap features "Once a Marine, Always a Marine" and "Semper Fi" embroidered alongside the iconic U.S. Marines Globe & Anchor logo. Made from durable brushed cotton twill, this cap offers long-lasting comfort and a classic low-profile fit. The internal sweatband ensures added comfort, while 2 reinforced vent holes promote airflow for a breathable experience. The adjustable hook and loop strap closure provides a customizable fit.
